verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's marketplace lets you filter offers by GPU type via the UI, CLI and API (e.g., gpu_name=RTX_4090). It also has a verified Secure Cloud datacenter tier, and community users cite cheap consumer and previous-generation cards like the RTX 3090. However, nothing in the evidence names H100, H200, B200 or any other current-generation datacenter GPU as available. Missing for 10: evidence that H100/H200/B200-class GPUs are listed, availability or pricing comparisons across GPU generations, independent corroboration of current-gen datacenter GPU supply.
